reviewTrust.trustRoot: A repository-local public key registry is trusted only when its SHA-256 is pinned outside the repository via BEWT_TRUSTED_REVIEWERS_SHA256. Missing pin means all approvals remain untrusted.

rq3.interpretation: PASS means all registered candidates have complete, source-bound 1+3 trial evidence and the research outcomes are calculable; it does not mean every candidate passed.
rq3.flakinessDefinition: A candidate is flaky when its initial run and three reruns do not all have the same derived JUnit outcome; rerunFailureRate and allTrialFailureRate use separate denominators.
rq3.reason: Source-bound protocol evidence is incomplete; reported historical outcomes remain separate and do not establish VALIDATED cases.
